author: felicepantaleo
body:
Introduces `TICLGeom`, a portable (host and device) SoA representation of the HGCAL and calorimeter geometry, and migrates HGCAL/TICL reconstruction, validation, and the associators off `hgcal::RecHitTools` onto it.

`hgcal::RecHitTools` is host only (it wraps `CaloGeometry`) and answers per detid through virtual and DDD lookups, so Alpaka reco cannot use it on device. `TICLGeom` exposes the same per cell quantities as flat columns usable identically on host and in kernels, with an O(1)-class detid lookup, so the geometry can move to GPU alongside TICL algorithms.

### Design

- **DataFormats (`CondFormats/HGCalObjects`).** `TICLGeomSoA` is a `SoABlocks` layout (`common | silicon | scint`) holding every detid keyed `RecHitTools` quantity; cell type specific columns are allocated only for the cells that have them. `TICLGeomLookupSoA` maps rawDetId to the dense row by a bit shift coarse key plus a short in block binary search (no geometry constants; barrel detids fall back to a full binary search). `TICLGeomLayersSoA` holds the per layer positions (the `getPositionLayer` replacement). Host and device collections share the layout, with the automatic `CopyToDevice`.
- **EventSetup producers (`RecoHGCal/TICL/plugins/alpaka`).** Alpaka `ESProducer`s fill the columns by calling `RecHitTools`, so the values are exact by construction. Per subdetector instances: the default (empty label) is HGCal only, with a `withBarrel` instance for the barrel layer clustering.
- **Facade (`RecoLocalCalo/HGCalRecAlgos/interface/TICLGeomTools.h`).** `ticlgeom::Tools` mirrors the `RecHitTools` API over the three views: detid field methods are computed from the bits (correct for any detid), geometry derived methods read the columns, geometry wide getters read the scalars. The facade insulates the roughly 40 migrated modules from the SoA layout.

### Migration scope

`RecoHGCal/TICL`, `RecoLocalCalo/HGCalRecAlgos` and `HGCalRecProducers`, `RecoParticleFlow/PFClusterProducer`, `RecoEgamma/EgammaTools`, `RecoTauTag/RecoTau`, `PhysicsTools/TruthInfo`, `DPGAnalysis/HGCalNanoAOD`, `Validation/HGCalValidation`, `SimCalorimetry/HGCalAssociatorProducers`, plus the reco and HLT 75e33 EventSetup wiring. `Fireworks/Geometry` is intentionally left on `RecHitTools`, since the event display dump needs the full `CaloGeometry` and cell corners.

The associators build the tools object per event rather than as a shared member, to remove a data race in the global producers (same fix as the recent `HGCalAssociatorProducers` change).

Comparison on TTbar PU200, identical GEN-SIM and DIGI input through both legs, same backend. Physics neutral within numerical tolerance.

On the same PU200 sample: total job time real about 3.5 percent lower.


`RecoHGCal/TICL/test/TICLGeomAnalyzer` is a closure test that verifies every column and scalar against `RecHitTools`, per cell, on host and on device (`alpaka_cuda_async`), for both `Run4D121` and `Run4D122`. Built and run against `CMSSW_20_1_X_2026-07-24-1100`.
title: TICLGeom: a portable SoA geometry
